title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

## Features
- npc/hotkey can start sex, cuddle, punishment scenes
- ability add scene descriptions
- mini-sexgame
- Injury Engine support
- May ask/order/punish actor
- DOM support

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- MageLight UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)
author: goodprovider
changelog:
### Creatures
- Creatures are recognized; animation lists show **MC** (male creature) and **FC** (female creature)
- Filtering by gender or position lists only your creature's animations: a wolf gets canine ones
- Scenes started by NPCs or actions with a creature now pick creature animations
- Fixed: a werewolf player got human animations at the last stage and in the Description Editor

### Orgasm engine
- Fixed: arousing an actor stayed blocked for a full minute after an orgasm, not just the afterglow
